title: F, J and the space bar
summary: Find the two keys with a raised bump, and learn to come back to them without looking.
intro: Every other lesson in this course depends on this one. F and J carry a small raised bump so your index fingers can find them by touch alone, and every reach you learn later starts and ends here. Rest both index fingers on the bumps, let the other fingers fall onto the keys beside them, and keep your eyes on the screen rather than on your hands.
congrats: That is the hardest part of touch typing already behind you: not the letters, but the habit of not looking. Your fingers now know two keys by feel. The next lesson adds two more, and the pattern will start to feel familiar much faster than this one did.

screens.text: Left index finger. Slide it across the middle row until you feel a raised bump — that is F. You never need to look for this key again; the bump is there so you can find it in the dark.
Tap it with the left index finger and let the finger settle back onto the key each time. Slow and even beats fast and scattered.
Right index finger, same middle row, same raised bump. F and J are the two anchors your hands return to after every single reach in this course.
Now alternate. Notice that neither hand has to move — only the two index fingers do any work.
The space bar belongs to your right thumb. Let the thumb rest on it and press from where it already is; there is no need to lift the hand or aim.
screens.hint: Press the space bar to continue

screens.content: fff jjj fff jjj fj jf
screens.text: Thumb for the space, index fingers for the letters. Three separate fingers, one rhythm.
A short burst. Type whatever appears; accuracy first, speed will follow on its own.
Keep both index fingers touching their bumps between taps. If you have to hunt for a key, you have drifted off the row.
screens.content:
jf jf
jf fj jfjf
fff jjj

screens.text: Once more, a little longer. Try to keep your eyes off your hands for the whole burst.
Last one. If this feels dull, that is the point — dull is what a habit feels like while it is being built.
screens.content:
fj fj
jf fj jfjf
ffff jjj
